player_prompt.intro:
Amogele wa go Lights Out! O na le gridi ya {size}x{size} ya maswe.
Yeo e nneleng ya gago ke go tlhoka maswe OTLHE (e bopilwe ke '.')
Fa o batla maswe, o a tlhoka yona YA ENA le ba bangwe ba yona (kwa ntle/kwa borwa/morago/molema).
Ngwana [row col] go batla maswe (0-indeksed, kwa hoo, kgetho e ntshe ya 0-{max_index}).
O na le dikgetho tse {max_turns} tsa go o hloile puzzle.
Taolo: 'O' = maswe a tsamaya, '.' = maswe a tlhokafala

board.current_state:
Tsheko ya grido ya tshimologo (Lekgetho {moves_made}, {moves_left} dikgetho di shileng, {completion}% e feletswe):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kgato e tshwanetse go nna ka sebopego sa [row col] fa mola le kholomo di le dipalo tse di feletseng tsa 0 go ya kwa {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Congratulations! You solved the puzzle in {moves_used} moves!
